answer: Stamp shops that only copy dies cannot staff a single heat at a licensed forge. The applicant locks 36.7 POA and draws one 90 g iron blank. In 11 minutes they must upset it on a surveyed basalt anvil at 1180-1220 C, quench once, and press a velvet cloth on the warm face for 40 seconds, leaving a 0.12-0.18 mm crush map. The notary files the anvil's 64-byte pit print with that map. A reused blank ID, a second heat, or a copied nap map burns 15.3 POA. If the anvil cracks before the first quench, 27.9 POA is refunded and the hearth stays cold 44 hours.
